properties.name: visual_style
properties.comment: How the bar draws: blocks, continuous, marquee, pulse, marching stripes or laser etch. A change restarts the animation phase and reselects the effects.

table.description: How the bar draws: blocks, continuous, marquee, pulse, marching stripes or laser etch.

hand: written: animation_phase_ = 0.0; sync_effects(FrameClock::now()); update_animation_registration(); invalidate(Dirty::paint | Dirty::semantics)

properties.name: overlay_style
properties.comment: The overlay drawn over the bar: none or moving stripes. A change restarts the animation phase and reselects the effects.
hand: written: animation_phase_ = 0.0; sync_effects(FrameClock::now()); update_animation_registration(); invalidate(Dirty::paint | Dirty::semantics)

properties.name: stripe_width
properties.comment: The stripes' width, 2 to 32 pixels (else std::invalid_argument).
prepare: require_finite(incoming, "progress stripe width must be finite");
if (incoming < 2.0 || incoming > 32.0) throw std::invalid_argument("progress stripe width must be between 2 and 32 pixels");

properties.name: animation_appearance
properties.comment: The animation's colours and extents; each extent finite and within its range, else std::invalid_argument.

properties.name: animation_enabled
properties.comment: Whether the bar animates; turning it off resets the phase.
hand: written: reset the phase when off, update_animation_registration, invalidate

properties.name: animation_period
properties.comment: The period of the indeterminate motion, at least 100 milliseconds (else std::invalid_argument).
hand: written: restart the frame clock, invalidate

properties.name: effect
properties.comment: The registered effect program drawn over the bar, by name (effect programs, design note section 7); empty takes the visual style's own, or the theme's.

table.description: The registered effect program drawn over the bar; empty takes the visual style's own.

hand: written: detach the effect, sync_effects, update_animation_registration, invalidate

properties.name: effect_seed
properties.comment: The seed of the bar's effects; none derives it from the stable ID and the effect's name, so runs and checksums reproduce. A change restarts the effects.

table.description: The effect's seed; null derives it from the stable ID and the effect's name.

hand: written: detach both effects, sync_effects, invalidate

properties.name: effect_input
properties.comment: The input the bar grants its effect: none, the pointer, or the pointer and keys. The bar never takes focus, so a key grant delivers nothing.

table.description: The input the bar grants its effect: none, the pointer, or the pointer and keys.

hand: written: grant the effect instance the input, invalidate

properties.name: motion_policy
properties.comment: Whether the bar's animation and effects move: disabled or paused stops them, keeping the phase; reduced swaps motion for a still form. A view onto the bar's policy; effective_motion_policy adds the window's reduced-motion setting.
hand: a view onto motion_policy_: write_view keeps set_motion_policy's timer registration and invalidation; set_animation_paused, set_reduced_motion and the two-flag overload were read-modify-write shorthands over it and are removed
